compound_name_audit.rule: Classification uses only the text recorded in each row's evidence. This audit splits, merges or renames nothing; a split needs explicit source evidence and a reviewed decision recorded as split_basis on the rows.

categories.SPLIT_RECORDED_WITH_BASIS: Already recorded as separate rows, each carrying split_basis (source text + decision).
categories.LABEL_COMPONENT_ALREADY_FLAGGED: The row itself says it is a component of a compound label; nothing to decide here.
categories.DISTRICT_QUALIFIER: Parentheses carry the district name, not an alias.
categories.LOCALITY_QUALIFIER: Parentheses carry the populated centre that identifies an unnamed or ambiguous quebrada, not an alias.
categories.PARENTHETICAL_ALIAS_OR_SUBNAME_PENDING: Parentheses carry a second name (alias, sub-name, river or sector); not adjudicated.
categories.SOURCE_TABLE_LOCALITY_LABEL: The source table prints the same compound as populated centre and quebrada: a locality label, kept as printed.
categories.SOURCE_TABLE_SINGLE_CELL_COMPOUND: The source table prints the compound in one quebrada cell: kept as one row until the table is reread.
categories.ENUMERATED_DISTINCT_NAMES_IN_SOURCE: The recorded source text enumerates the names with plural 'quebradas': explicit split candidate.
categories.NUMBERED_SERIES_IN_SOURCE: The recorded source text names a numbered series (1, 2, 3 / I, II): split candidate, same pattern as El Establo.
categories.SOURCE_TEXT_NOT_READ: The compound comes from a file name or an automated title reading; the source text naming it was not recorded.
categories.SECONDARY_OR_LIST_SOURCE_ONLY: Only a press item or a district list carries the compound: needs a primary source first.
